remarks: Discover this charming second-floor unit in the heart of Byram - a vibrant and walkable Greenwich neighborhood known for its local charm, strong community feel, and unbeatable convenience. This well-kept 1-bedroom apartment offers a thoughtfully laid-out floor plan featuring a spacious living room, a separate kitchen with plenty of cabinet space, a full bathroom, and a comfortable bedroom with great natural light. Enjoy the quiet, residential setting while still being just steps from Byram's best amenities - including Byram Park and Beach, the public pool, local restaurants & coffee shops. Easy access to I-95 and the Port Chester Metro-North station makes commuting a breeze. Available for immediate occupancy - come experience the perfect blend of affordability, location, and lifestyle in one of Greenwich's most accessible neighborhoods.
